name: Hairy Cell Leukemia Variant

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Hairy Cell Leukemia Variant Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of atypical hairy cells with prominent nucleoli and irregular cytoplasmic projections on peripheral blood smear
Expression of CD11c, CD103, CD20, and CD22 with absence or weak expression of CD25 and CD123
Bone marrow infiltration with interstitial pattern and absence of classic reticulin fibrosis
Absence of BRAF V600E mutation (differentiates from classic hairy cell leukemia)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (morphology, immunophenotype, and bone marrow infiltration) must be met; absence of BRAF V600E mutation supports diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of morphology, immunophenotyping, and molecular studies to distinguish from classic hairy cell leukemia.

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing atypical hairy cells with irregular cytoplasmic projections
Cytopenias including anemia, thrombocytopenia, and variable leukocyte counts
Bone marrow biopsy with interstitial infiltration and absence of reticulin fibrosis
imaging: Splenomegaly on abdominal ultrasound or CT scan
other: Negative tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase (TRAP) staining compared to classic HCL

redFlags: Massive splenomegaly causing abdominal discomfort or early satiety
